name: Trench Combat 💥
desc:
💥 Trench Combat is a team PvP trench game! 

🚩 Utilize different classes to cross no man's land or tunnel underground and capture all the enemy trenches!

Playable on PC 🖥️, Mobile 📱 and Console 🎮
